description: Saves a delivery location to the connected person's WaitApp account under a label such as Home or Work, so later orders can use it. Saving a label the person already has updates that location. Up to 10 can be saved. Notes are for the rider, for example a gate code, floor or landmark.

address.description: Full address: street or estate, area, city

label.description: A short name, e.g. Home, Work, Mum's place

makeDefault.description: Make this the person's default location

name: save_location
title: Save a delivery location
